resultat: Merab Dvalishvili bat Sean O'Malley par décision unanime après 5 rounds.
resultat_en: Merab Dvalishvili defeats Sean O'Malley by unanimous decision after 5 rounds.
contexte: Au Sphere, près de Las Vegas, Merab Dvalishvili bat Sean O'Malley aux points et devient champion des poids coqs.
contexte_en: At Sphere, near Las Vegas, Merab Dvalishvili beat Sean O'Malley on points to become bantamweight champion.
